# Copilot Instructions for joeyjamesbishop.github.io

## Project Overview
This is a personal portfolio website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The site showcases projects, skills, and professional information.

## Repository Structure
- **HTML (43.7%)**: Core structure and content of the portfolio
- **CSS (37.1%)**: Styling and responsive design
- **JavaScript (19.2%)**: Interactivity and dynamic features

## Key Guidelines for Copilot

### Code Style & Conventions
- Follow semantic HTML5 best practices
- Use CSS variables for consistent theming and maintainability
- Keep JavaScript modular and DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself)
- Ensure cross-browser compatibility

### Performance & Accessibility
- Optimize images and assets for web performance
- Maintain WCAG accessibility standards
- Implement responsive design for mobile-first approach
- Test on multiple devices and screen sizes

### Git & Version Control
- Write clear, descriptive commit messages
- Keep commits focused on single features or fixes
- Use branches for new features or major changes

### Best Practices
- Use semantic HTML tags (header, nav, section, footer, etc.)
- Minimize global scope pollution in JavaScript
- Use CSS Grid and Flexbox for layouts
- Comment complex logic and CSS techniques
- Test changes locally before pushing

## Common Tasks
When assisting with:
- **Portfolio Updates**: Ensure changes maintain consistent design language
- **Feature Additions**: Consider how new features integrate with existing site
- **Bug Fixes**: Document the issue and solution clearly
- **Performance**: Optimize for Core Web Vitals
- **Styling**: Maintain consistency with existing color schemes and typography
